L1.name: Reframe
L1.procedure: Separate the stated solution from the outcome; change the question or system boundary and examine consequences.

L2.name: Invert
L2.procedure: Describe how to guarantee failure; invert causal contributors into testable alternative rules.

L3.name: Subtract
L3.procedure: Remove steps, burdens or components while preserving required functions; inspect the tradeoff.

L4.name: Provoke
L4.procedure: Use a clearly hypothetical extreme to extract a useful principle; translate it back into a bounded option.

L5.name: Connect
L5.procedure: Map a structurally analogous system onto the problem; test relationships and where the analogy breaks.

S1.name: Map and disrupt
S1.procedure: Map conventions, competitors and unserved jobs; challenge a convention relevant to the bottleneck.

S2.name: Resolve contradictions
S2.procedure: State which improvement worsens which property; separate conditions, resources or timing to seek resolutions.

S3.name: Constrain
S3.procedure: Treat fixed resources as design inputs and redesign around them without silently relaxing limits.

Y1.name: Systems leverage
Y1.procedure: Map stocks, flows, feedback, delays and incentives; compare interventions and second-order effects.

Y2.name: Causes and first principles
Y2.procedure: Separate observations from assumptions; compare causal models and identify discriminating evidence.

H1.name: Inhabit
H1.procedure: Reconstruct a specific stakeholder's struggling moment from evidence; label imagined needs as hypotheses.
H1.output: Job, friction, workaround and validation question

H2.name: Perception and behavior
H2.procedure: Examine attention, framing, incentives and barriers; propose bounded behavioral interventions.

H3.name: Mine experience
H3.procedure: Extract tensions and useful specifics from supplied lived or project experience without inventing it.

C1.name: Sequence
C1.procedure: Arrange causal or experiential beats while preserving established causality and knowledge boundaries.

C2.name: Repeatable engine
C2.procedure: Define a rule that generates fresh instances; test multiple instances and failure limits.

D1.name: Diverge and combine
D1.procedure: Generate across distinct dimensions, cluster mechanisms and recombine useful differences.

D2.name: Test and learn
D2.procedure: Find the assumption that changes the decision; define the cheapest discriminating test, falsifier and next action.
D2.output: Experiment or decision test with explicit unknowns
